note: A documented policy for how a future session or agent working in this repository should load context. This is NOT enforced by any runtime 'context compiler' -- no such system exists in this repo, and building one was explicitly declined as disproportionate to this project's actual scope (a dental practice marketing site's design-extraction side project). This file exists so the intended behavior is written down and reviewable, not to claim it is mechanically enforced.
loadOrder: design-intelligence locked decisions (see design-intelligence/README.md and the plan file referenced in commit messages)
task-specific constraints stated in the current request
relevant existing scripts/lib code for the stage or capability being touched
evidence on demand (artifacts/evidence/*, artifacts/graph/evidence-graph.json) rather than loading the entire evidence set
external research only when a claim cannot be resolved from the above
defaultDoNotLoad: the full raw mirror (design-intelligence/cache/objects/, design-intelligence/artifacts/mirror/files/) unless a specific asset is under investigation
the full execution-intelligence ledger, if one exists, unless investigating a specific session's behavior
external documentation already captured in evidence/sources or a prior grounding record, unless it may have changed

freshnessGuidance.lockedDecisions: valid until explicitly superseded by the user
freshnessGuidance.packageVersions: revalidate live before any version-sensitive claim -- see design-intelligence/scripts/migration-assessment.mjs for the pattern
freshnessGuidance.externalDocumentation: revalidate live before relying on a specific claimed capability, especially anything affecting a release gate
freshnessGuidance.cacheObjects: governed by design-intelligence/lib/cache.mjs FRESHNESS_MODES, not by this file
